profile.headline: Software Engineer at Emporia Research
profile.summary: As a software engineer at Emporia Research, I leverage my expertise in Python, TypeScript, and React to develop and integrate software solutions for providing market research insights. I have a strong background in software development, having worked as a team lead at Shippo and a senior software engineer at Silicon Labs. I am passionate about creating innovative and efficient software solutions that enhance the performance and reliability of complex systems. I am always eager to learn new technologies and apply them to real-world problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Next.js · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned integrations between Warehousing software and Warehouse Automation, Labor Management and
Yard Management vendors

- Defined standards and created tooling for implementing Datadog monitoring within Terraform
- Built multiple event-based (Kafka) Java Spring Boot applications
- Designed front end application for carton exception handling using TypeScript/React/GraphQL
- Migrated monolithic TSQL databases into Google Cloud Postgres SPDBs
- Created tooling to automate hierarchical Avro schema validation
- Overhauled runbook system and trained team members for supporting oncall rotation
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Terraform · Spring Boot · System Monitoring

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead of the Onboarding and Setup team

- Architected and developed Go/HTTP/gRPC-based microservices
- Designed front end applications using TypeScript/React/Redux
- Overhauled OAuth2 authorization framework and token management
- Created SumoLogic monitoring dashboards and alerts for microservice deployments
- Developed infrastructure to abstract local Docker development and Kubernetes production environment differences
positions.insights: Skills: Go · Kubernetes · Docker · Python · Django

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed Python/Tornado/RabbitMQ-based backend
- Designed front end applications using JavaScript/React/Redux

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Manage and architect for an internal software development team focused on validation tools.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am responsible for the validation software framework for power management chips.

- Developed software APIs using PyVISA for oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, digital multimeters, signal generators, electronic loads.
- Contributed to the PyVISA project with improvements to their hardware mock code. 
- Experienced in developing unit tests and hardware mocks for unit testing. 
- Versed in PMBus communication protocol for DUT control
- Responsible for validation test programming methodologies and data collection and storage methods.
- Involved with validation test creation

positions.title: Electrical Validation Engineer
positions.description:
I do tool development and speed analysis for networking SoCs.

 - Involved with electrical validation for the QorIQ family of products.
 - Designing a web based test automation framework written in Python using Django.
 - Deployed production web services using nginx with FastCGI and Varnish cache accelerator.
 - Implemented graphical test automation tool using PyGtk.
 - Created graphical framework written in Python to develop abstractions of testbenches or SoCs.
 - Responsible for creating memory map configurations for QorIQ SoCs.
 - Provided methods to translate device definition into toolchain code for configuring and executing test cases.

positions.title: Failure Analysis Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented automatic TIFF to JPEG conversion on the failure analysis web pages at Austin Technology and Manufacturing Center (ATMC).
 - Created team review web page for the failure analysis group at ATMC.
 - Designed new database tables for failure analysis database at ATMC.
 - Coded new web pages for second revision of the failure analysis database.
